title: Berger-Hopf Standard Model: Artifact-Backed Geometric Physics Research Framework
description: Artifact-backed mathematical and computational research framework investigating candidate Berger-Hopf geometric organization of Standard Model-associated structures. The repository provides reproducible calculations and explicit claim boundaries; it does not claim empirical validation or a complete Standard Model derivation.
